scope: Known random-affix bounds for the optimum-reference discussion, not statistical expected rolls

referenceProposal.primaryWeaponAffix: Appropriate direct physical or magical attack at the approved rank maximum; deterministic initial reference, not a claim of maximum DPS.
referenceProposal.skillDamage: Separate skill-heavy comparison; can coexist with the matching direct attack once at least two random slots are available. Never add physical and magical bonuses to the same channel.
referenceProposal.remainingWeaponSlots: Choose an explicit eligible stat later; do not silently omit slots when claiming a full optimum.
referenceProposal.armor: Allocate HP/physical/magical defense through legal distinct per-item slots. With only one slot, compare separate physical/magical defense loadouts rather than giving both.
referenceProposal.critical: No forced critical/proc affixes in the deterministic reference. Existing class skill effects remain unchanged.
referenceProposal.sockets: Keep separate from random affixes; stone bonuses use their own equipment and duplicate restrictions.

notes: R6 normal Strength/Intelligence affix maximum is currently 8, not 12. Special crafted limits are not finalized.
P/M direct attack and P/M skill-damage reference maxima match in pairs. Equal numeric maxima do not guarantee identical class DPS.
Skill damage has approved maximum reference values, but its random roll distribution/range is not defined; do not manufacture an expected random average.
No baseline damage or survivability increase is applied to all classes from the single-attribute socket bound. A specific legal gem loadout must be selected.
